text:
Harper: Quick mini-audit from today's usability session: users didn't notice the ordering controls in the rule rows. They expected a visible affordance when two rules had the same numeric priority. Thinking: add a subtle 'priority ribbon' (thin left-edge bar) + a one-time onboarding tooltip that points to the ribbon and explains actions (keyboard + drag). Jun: Ribbon sounds less scary than 'conflict' pill. Can we keep it low-contrast by default and increase contrast on hover/focus? Also suggest a micro-animation when an import creates overlapping priorities to draw attention gently. Josie: Accessibility notes: ribbon must be reachable by keyboard and describable by screen readers. Proposed SR announcer for dynamic appearance: ```
Ordering notice: 2 rules share priority in Route Checkout. Press Shift+O to open ordering help.
``` Make onboarding tooltip dismissible and persistent in the help drawer for discoverability. Riley: From the preview side, when a user opens the onboarding help we should show a live mini-preview of the match order (inline, not full sim). That preview can be produced by a light-weight endpoint so we don't re-run heavy sims. Maybe POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview with proposed action: {action: "move", rule_id: "uuid", commit: false}. Sam: Dev note: agree on preview endpoint. Suggested API: POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview body {proposed_changes:[{rule_id:"...", action:"promote|demote|pin"}]} -> returns a small list of rule-order and sample-match counts. That allows the onboarding tooltip to show a sample snapshot. Harper: Copy for the onboarding tooltip draft: "Rules with the same priority are evaluated in list order. Use the ribbon to reorder or press Shift+O for quick actions (Move up / Move down / Pin)." Include a small keyboard hint in the tooltip. Josie: Keyboard-first behavior: Shift+O opens the ordering help overlay; inside overlay arrow keys move focus between rules, Space toggles a selected rule into 'pin' mode, and Ctrl+Arrow moves it up/down. We'll add focus/return tests for screen-reader flows. Jun: Micro-animation idea: when import produces overlap, animate the ribbon with a single pulse and also surface a muted toast: "Ordering notice: some rules share priority — Open help (Shift+O)". Toast should link to overlay and be kept in the tray for keyboard users. ux-bot: Uploaded mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/2179990000-priority-ribbon-onboarding.png shows ribbon states, tooltip, and overlay keyboard hints. Sam: Implementation checklist: 1) add ribbon element in rule row (accessible, tooltip anchor) 2) onboarding tooltip with keyboard hint and persistent help drawer link 3) aria-live announcer for programmatic appearance 4) small POST /routes/:id/ordering-preview for inline preview 5) keep full sim unchanged (no heavy runs) 6) unit tests for keyboard + SR narration. Harper: Nice. Next steps: Josie will add SR copy and the announcer snippet into the a11y doc; Sam will draft the preview API schema; Jun & I will prototype ribbon micro-interactions for next design review. Thanks! :raised_hands:
